Thanks Dev — attaching our security requirements and a short success criteria draft so you can validate. Quick note on slots: May 5 morning works best for our CTO and procurement.

Proposed Success Criteria (Medicore draft):
1) End-to-end generation accuracy: API responses match curated templates for 95% of sampled prompts
2) Latency: 95th percentile < 600ms for 256-token responses from the east-us region (we'll specify region during kickoff)
3) Data handling: no customer PHI retained beyond session — need confirmation of retention window and logs
4) Operational: ability to run replay tests and export KV cache for debugging

Attachment: Medicore-security-requirements.pdf (application/pdf)

Alyssa Chen
